subject: Penpot clean start after coordination worker repair
body: CLEAN_START. Create one fresh board named 00 — Westside Watch Homepage — CLEAN START and build the first real editorial homepage foundation from zero. Do not reuse or copy old test boards. Keep old boards only as untouched archive. Use Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink #252525, First Light Gold #A2872A restrained, Watch Night #102A43 purposeful. Build a mature masthead/navigation, editorial hero, architectural 5:8 field, Chinese feature module, fine rules and generous whitespace. Preserve editable native Penpot layers. Export the exact new board and visually verify it.
design_brief: Westside Watch: quiet architectural Christian editorial publication at dawn; asymmetry, paper, stone, light, disciplined hierarchy; no SaaS cards, rounded panels, generic templates, or gold overload.
